title: Ovqat, ichimlik va kafeda buyurtma berish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida kafe va restoranda kamida beshta ovqat va ichimlikni muloyim buyurtma qilasiz (I'd like / Can I have), narxni so‘raysiz, hisobni so‘raysiz va naqd yoki karta bilan to‘laysiz.

vocab.w: a cup of / a glass of

scenes.title: Kafega xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yana ko‘rishganimizdan xursandman. Oldingi darsda hozirgi oddiy zamonni, ya’ni har kuni nima qilishimizni aytishni o‘rgandik: “I drink tea every morning.” Bugun shu choyni kafeda buyurtma qilamiz!
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we are going to a café. You will order food and drinks, ask about prices and pay the bill.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun kafega boramiz. Ovqat va ichimlik buyurtma qilasiz, narxlarni so‘raysiz va hisobni to‘laysiz.

scenes.title: Ichimliklar
scenes.say_native: Avval ichimliklar. “Tea” — choy. Inglizlar “tea” deganda odatda qora choyni tushunadi, ko‘k choy esa “green tea”. “Coffee” — qahva, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: “KO-fi”, “kofe” emas. “Water” — suv, “juice” — sharbat, masalan “orange juice” — apelsin sharbati. “Milk” — sut. “Hot chocolate” — issiq kakao.
scenes.say: Tea. Green tea. Coffee. Water. Orange juice. Milk. Hot chocolate.
scenes.say_uz: Choy. Ko‘k choy. Qahva. Suv. Apelsin sharbati. Sut. Issiq kakao.

scenes.title: Ovqatlar
scenes.say_native: Endi ovqatlar. “Soup” — sho‘rva, “salad” — salat, “sandwich” — sendvich. “Chicken” — tovuq go‘shti, “rice” — guruch yoki palov kabi guruchli taom, “bread” — non. Shirinliklardan “cake” — tort yoki pirojniy, “ice cream” — muzqaymoq. E’tibor bering, “chicken” so‘zi ham tirik tovuqni, ham uning go‘shtini bildiradi.
scenes.say: Soup. Salad. Sandwich. Chicken. Rice. Bread. Cake. Ice cream.
scenes.say_uz: Sho‘rva. Salat. Sendvich. Tovuq. Guruch. Non. Tort. Muzqaymoq.

scenes.title: Go‘sht va boshqalar
scenes.say_native: Yana bir nechta foydali so‘z. “Beef” — mol go‘shti, “lamb” — qo‘y go‘shti, “fish” — baliq, “eggs” — tuxum. “Lamb” so‘zida oxirgi “b” o‘qilmaydi: “lem”. Britaniyada qovurilgan kartoshka “chips” deyiladi, Amerikada esa “fries”. Amerikada “chips” deganda yupqa paketdagi chipslar tushuniladi, Britaniyada ular “crisps”.
scenes.say: Beef. Lamb. Fish. Eggs. Fish and chips, please.
scenes.say_uz: Mol go‘shti. Qo‘y go‘shti. Baliq. Tuxum. Baliq va kartoshka, iltimos.

scenes.title: Idishlar: a cup of, a glass of

examples.t: A glass of orange juice, please.

scenes.say_native: Ichimlik va ovqatni ko‘pincha idishi bilan aytamiz. “A cup of tea” — bir piyola choy, “a cup of coffee” — bir chashka qahva. “A glass of water” — bir stakan suv. “A bottle of water” — bir shisha suv. “A piece of cake” — bir bo‘lak tort. O‘zbekchada ham “bir piyola choy” deymiz, demak bu tuzilma sizga tanish.
scenes.say: A cup of tea. A glass of water. A bottle of water. A piece of cake.
scenes.say_uz: Bir piyola choy. Bir stakan suv. Bir shisha suv. Bir bo‘lak tort.

scenes.title: Kafeda qisqa usul
board: a coffee = a cup of coffee
two teas = two cups of tea
a water = a bottle / glass of water

examples.t: Two coffees and a tea, please.
examples.uz: Ikkita qahva va bitta choy, iltimos.

scenes.say_native: Kafeda odamlar qisqaroq gapiradi. “A coffee” — bitta qahva, “two teas” — ikkita choy, “two coffees” — ikkita qahva. Bu yerda “a coffee” aslida “a cup of coffee” ma’nosini beradi. Bunday qisqa shakl faqat buyurtma berishda tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Two coffees and a tea, please. I like coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita qahva va bitta choy, iltimos. Men qahvani yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: A bread emas
board: ✓ a piece of bread / a slice of bread

examples.t: Can I have some bread, please?

scenes.say_native: Ko‘p uchraydigan xato: “a bread” yoki “a rice” deyish. O‘zbekchada “bitta non” deymiz, lekin ingliz tilida “bread” va “rice” sanalmaydigan so‘zlar. Ular bilan “a” ishlatilmaydi. To‘g‘risi: “some bread” — biroz non, yoki “a piece of bread”, “a slice of bread” — bir bo‘lak non. Guruch uchun ham shunday: “some rice”.
scenes.say: Not: a bread. Say: some bread, or a slice of bread.
scenes.say_uz: A bread emas. Some bread yoki a slice of bread deng.

scenes.title: Idishni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta bo‘sh joy bor. Har biriga mos idish so‘zini toping: piyola, shisha, bo‘lak yoki stakan. Baland ovozda butun iborani ayting, masalan: “a cup of…” Esda tuting: suyuq ichimliklar uchun piyola, stakan yoki shisha, tort va non uchun esa bo‘lak ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: A what of tea? A what of water? A what of cake? A what of juice?
scenes.say_uz: Bir nima choy? Bir nima suv? Bir nima tort? Bir nima sharbat?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “a cup of tea”, “a bottle of water”, “a piece of cake”, “a glass of juice”. Agar ikkinchisida “a glass of water” desangiz ham, ma’no jihatidan to‘g‘ri, faqat bu safar shisha so‘ralgan edi. Har doim “of” ni yengil, qisqa aytishga harakat qiling, bu haqda dars oxirida yana gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: A cup of tea. A bottle of water. A piece of cake. A glass of juice.
scenes.say_uz: Bir piyola choy. Bir shisha suv. Bir bo‘lak tort. Bir stakan sharbat.

scenes.title: Menyu bo‘limlari
scenes.say_native: Restoran menyusi odatda bo‘limlarga bo‘linadi. “Starter” — birinchi, yengil taom, Amerikada uni “appetizer” deyishadi. “Main course” — asosiy taom. “Dessert” — shirinlik, urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “di-ZYOT”. Uni “desert” — sahro so‘zi bilan adashtirmang.
scenes.say: For a starter, the soup. For the main course, chicken. For dessert, ice cream.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi taomga sho‘rva. Asosiy taomga tovuq. Shirinlikka muzqaymoq.

scenes.title: I would like — men … xohlardim

examples.t: I'd like a cup of tea, please.
We'd like a table for two.
examples.uz: Bizga ikki kishilik stol kerak edi.

scenes.say_native: Endi eng muhim qism: muloyim buyurtma. Birinchi ibora: “I would like” — men … xohlardim. Og‘zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqartiriladi: “I’d like”. Undan keyin narsa keladi: “I’d like a coffee, please.” Bu ibora “I want” dan ancha muloyim.
scenes.say: I'd like a coffee, please. I'd like the chicken salad. We'd like two teas, please.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta qahva bersangiz. Tovuqli salat bersangiz. Bizga ikkita choy bersangiz.

scenes.title: Can I have…? / Could I have…?
board: Can I have a tea, please?
Could I have the menu, please? (muloyimroq)

examples.t: Could I have a glass of water, please?

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi usul — savol shaklida so‘rash: “Can I have a tea, please?” — menga choy bera olasizmi? “Could I have…?” esa yanada muloyimroq: “Could I have the menu, please?” — menyuni bera olasizmi? Ikki yoki undan ortiq kishi bo‘lsangiz, “Can we have…?” deysiz.
scenes.say: Can I have a tea, please? Could I have the menu, please? Can we have some water?
scenes.say_uz: Choy bera olasizmi? Menyuni bera olasizmi? Bizga suv bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: I'll have… — buyurtma iborasi
scenes.say_native: Ofitsiant “What would you like?” deb so‘raganda, inglizlar ko‘pincha “I’ll have…” deb javob beradi: “I’ll have the soup, please.” Bu yerdagi “I’ll” kelasi zamonga oid, uni keyingi darslarda batafsil o‘rganamiz. Hozircha uni tayyor ibora sifatida eslab qoling: buyurtmani aytayotganda juda tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: What would you like? I'll have the soup, please. And I'll have the fish.
scenes.say_uz: Nima olasiz? Men sho‘rva olaman. Men esa baliq olaman.

scenes.title: O‘zbek va rus tilidan farq
board: O‘zbekcha: Choy bering. → ✗ Give me tea.
Ruscha: Дайте чай. → ✗ Give me tea.
✓ Can I have a tea, please?
scenes.say_native: Nega bu muhim? O‘zbekchada “Choy bering” yoki ruschada “Дайте чай” desak, ohang to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, odobsizlik emas. Ingliz tilida esa buyruq shakli “Give me a tea” xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi odamga qo‘pol eshitiladi. Inglizlar iltimosni savol yoki “would” bilan yumshatadi. Shu sababli kafeda buyruq emas, “Can I have…?”
scenes.say: Not: Give me a tea. Say: Can I have a tea, please?
scenes.say_uz: Give me a tea emas. Can I have a tea, please deng.

scenes.title: I want va Give me
board: ✓ Could I have the menu, please?
scenes.say_native: Ikki keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi: “I want a coffee.” Grammatika jihatidan to‘g‘ri, lekin kafeda bola gapirayotgandek, talabchan eshitiladi. Ikkinchisi: “Give me the menu.” Bu buyruq. To‘g‘risi: “I’d like a coffee, please” va “Could I have the menu, please?” Yana bir xato: “please” ni unutish.
scenes.say: I'd like a coffee, please. Could I have the menu, please?
scenes.say_uz: Bitta qahva bersangiz. Menyuni bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Turli buyurtmalar
board: I'd like a hot chocolate, please.
Can I have a piece of cake?
Could we have two bottles of water?
scenes.say_native: Endi turli buyurtmalarni tinglang va takrorlang. E’tibor bering: har birida yoki “I’d like”, yoki “Can I have”, yoki “Could we have” bor, oxirida esa deyarli doim “please”. Tuzilma bir xil: muloyim boshlanish, keyin narsa va miqdor, oxirida “please”. Shu qolipni yodlasangiz, istalgan narsani buyurtma qila olasiz.
scenes.say: I'd like a hot chocolate, please. Can I have a piece of chocolate cake? Could we have two bottles of water, please?
scenes.say_uz: Issiq kakao bersangiz. Bir bo‘lak shokoladli tort bera olasizmi? Bizga ikki shisha suv bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Muloyim qiling
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta qo‘pol gapni muloyim buyurtmaga aylantiring. “I’d like”, “Can I have” yoki “Could we have” dan foydalaning va “please” ni unutmang. Uchinchisida “us” — biz, demak “we” bilan boshlang. Qaysi shaklni tanlashingiz muhim emas, asosiysi buyruq emas, iltimos bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Make these polite. Give me water. I want a sandwich. Give us two coffees.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni muloyim qiling. Menga suv bering. Sendvich istayman. Bizga ikkita qahva bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Can I have some water, please?
3) Could we have two coffees, please?
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar: “Can I have some water, please?” yoki “a glass of water”. Ikkinchisi: “I’d like a sandwich, please.” Uchinchisi: “Could we have two coffees, please?” Agar siz boshqa muloyim shaklni tanlagan bo‘lsangiz, masalan “Can I have a sandwich, please?”, bu ham to‘liq to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Can I have some water, please? I'd like a sandwich, please. Could we have two coffees, please?
scenes.say_uz: Suv bera olasizmi? Sendvich bersangiz. Bizga ikkita qahva bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Would you like…? — taklif
board: Would you like milk with it?
scenes.say_native: Ofitsiant yoki uy egasi sizga narsa taklif qilganda “Would you like…?” deydi: “Would you like some tea?” — choy ichasizmi? Javob qisqa: “Yes, please” — ha, iltimos, yoki “No, thank you” — yo‘q, rahmat. O‘zbekchada mehmon ko‘pincha avval “yo‘q” deydi, keyin rozi bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Would you like some tea? Yes, please. Would you like sugar? No, thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Choy ichasizmi? Ha, iltimos. Shakar qo‘shaymi? Yo‘q, rahmat.

scenes.title: like va would like
board: I like tea. = choyni yaxshi ko‘raman (umuman)
✗ Would you like tea? — Yes, I like.
scenes.say_native: Bu ikki ibora o‘xshash, lekin ma’nosi boshqa. “I like tea” — men umuman choyni yaxshi ko‘raman, bu oldingi darsdagi odat haqidagi gap. “I’d like tea” — hozir choy xohlardim, bu buyurtma. Xato: “Would you like some tea?” savoliga “Yes, I like” deb javob berish.
scenes.say: Would you like some tea? Yes, please. Do you like tea? Yes, I do.
scenes.say_uz: Choy ichasizmi? Ha, iltimos. Choyni yaxshi ko‘rasizmi? Ha.

scenes.title: Taklifga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Belgi qo‘yilganiga qarang: belgi “ha”, xoch “yo‘q” degani. Diqqat: uchinchi savol “Would you like” emas, “Do you like”, demak javob ham boshqacha bo‘ladi. Javobni qisqa, lekin to‘liq ayting: faqat “yes” yoki “no” emas, muloyim shakl bilan.
scenes.say: Would you like some water? Would you like a dessert? Do you like coffee?
scenes.say_uz: Suv ichasizmi? Shirinlik olasizmi? Qahvani yaxshi ko‘rasizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisiga — “Yes, please.” Ikkinchisiga — “No, thank you.” Uchinchisi umumiy savol, odat haqida: “Do you like coffee?” Javob — “Yes, I do”, xuddi oldingi darsdagi kabi. Agar uchinchisiga “Yes, please” degan bo‘lsangiz, “like” va “would like” farqini yana bir bor eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Yes, please. No, thank you. Yes, I do.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, iltimos. Yo‘q, rahmat. Ha, yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Ofitsiantning savollari
board: Eat in or take away? (US: for here or to go?)
scenes.say_native: Endi ofitsiant yoki kassir nima deyishini bilib olaylik. “Are you ready to order?” — buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz? “What can I get you?” — sizga nima olib kelay? “Anything else?” — yana biror narsa? Javob: “No, that’s all, thanks” — yo‘q, shu xolos. Britaniyada “Eat in or take away?”
scenes.say: Are you ready to order? What can I get you? Anything else? No, that's all, thanks. Eat in or take away? Take away, please.
scenes.say_uz: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz? Sizga nima olay? Yana biror narsa? Yo‘q, shu xolos, rahmat. Shu yerdami yoki olib ketasizmi? Olib ketaman.

scenes.title: Vaqt so‘rash: bir daqiqa
board: Can I have a minute, please?
scenes.say_native: Ba’zan menyuni o‘qishga vaqt kerak bo‘ladi. Shunda “Can I have a minute, please?” — bir daqiqa bera olasizmi? yoki “We’re not ready yet” — hali tayyor emasmiz, deysiz. Nima tanlashni bilmasangiz, ofitsiantdan maslahat so‘rang: “What do you recommend?” — nimani tavsiya qilasiz?
scenes.say: Are you ready to order? Not yet. Can I have a minute, please? What do you recommend?
scenes.say_uz: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz? Hali emas. Bir daqiqa bera olasizmi? Nimani tavsiya qilasiz?

scenes.title: Tinglang: kafeda kassada
board: Drink? Food? Eat in or take away?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Londondagi kichik kafe, Dilnoza kassada buyurtma beryapti. Diqqat bilan tinglang, keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz: u qanday ichimlik oldi, qanday ovqat oldi va shu yerda yeydimi yoki olib ketadimi?
scenes.say: Hi! What can I get you? Hi. Could I have a cup of tea, please? Sure. With milk? Yes, please. Anything else? Yes, I'd like a chicken sandwich. Eat in or take away? Eat in, please. OK, one tea and one chicken sandwich.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Sizga nima olay? Salom. Bir piyola choy bera olasizmi? Albatta. Sut bilanmi? Ha, iltimos. Yana biror narsa? Ha, tovuqli sendvich olardim. Shu yerdami yoki olib ketasizmi? Shu yerda. Yaxshi, bitta choy va bitta tovuqli sendvich.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Savollar: Dilnoza qanday ichimlik buyurtma qildi va unga nima qo‘shildi? Qanday ovqat oldi? U kafeda o‘tirib yeydimi yoki olib ketadimi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni yana bir marta eshitib chiqing va eslab qolgan so‘zlaringizni yozib oling.
scenes.say: What drink does she order? What food does she order? Does she eat in or take away?
scenes.say_uz: U qanday ichimlik oldi? Qanday ovqat oldi? Shu yerda yeydimi yoki olib ketadimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) A cup of tea with milk.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: u bir piyola sutli choy oldi — “a cup of tea with milk”. Ovqatga tovuqli sendvich — “a chicken sandwich”. U kafeda o‘tirib yeydi — “She eats in.” Dialogdagi muloyim iboralarni ham sanab chiqing: “Could I have”, “Yes, please”, “I’d like”, “Eat in, please”. Ularning hammasi bugun o‘rganganlarimiz.
scenes.say: She orders a cup of tea with milk and a chicken sandwich. She eats in.
scenes.say_uz: U bir piyola sutli choy va tovuqli sendvich oladi. U shu yerda yeydi.

scenes.title: Narxni so‘rash
board: How much is it? / How much does it cost?

examples.t: How much is a cup of tea?

scenes.say_native: Endi narxlar. Narxni so‘rash uchun “How much…?” ishlatiladi. Bitta narsa haqida — “How much is the coffee?” Ko‘plikdagi narsa haqida — “How much are the sandwiches?” Ya’ni “is” va “are” narsaga moslashadi. Umumiy savol: “How much is it?” yoki “How much does it cost?” — bu qancha turadi?
scenes.say: How much is the coffee? How much are the sandwiches? How much is that, please?
scenes.say_uz: Qahva qancha turadi? Sendvichlar qancha turadi? Hammasi qancha bo‘ldi?

scenes.title: Narxni aytish
scenes.say_native: Narxni aytish. Britaniyada pul birligi funt va pens. “£3. 50” “three pounds fifty” yoki qisqacha “three fifty” deb o‘qiladi, “pence” so‘zi odatda tushib qoladi. Bir funtdan kam bo‘lsa: “80p” — “eighty p”, ya’ni “eighty pi”. Amerikada: “$4. 75” — “four dollars seventy-five” yoki “four seventy-five”.
scenes.say: That's three pounds fifty, please. That's eighty p. That's four seventy-five.
scenes.say_uz: Uch funt ellik pens bo‘ldi. Sakson pens bo‘ldi. To‘rt dollar yetmish besh sent bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Narx savolidagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: ko‘plik bilan “is” ishlatish: “How much is the sandwiches?” To‘g‘risi “How much are…” Ikkinchisi: o‘zbekcha “Necha pul turadi?” ni so‘zma-so‘z aytib, “How much costs it?” deyish. Ingliz tilida savolda “does” yordamchisi kerak: “How much does it cost?”
scenes.say: How much are the sandwiches? How much does it cost? How much is it?
scenes.say_uz: Sendvichlar qancha? Bu qancha turadi? Bu qancha?

scenes.title: Narxni so‘rang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi: choyning narxini so‘rang. Ikkinchi: tortlarning narxini so‘rang, diqqat, ular ko‘plikda. Uchinchi: kassirga o‘xshab ekrandagi narxni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing: “That’s…” bilan boshlang. Narxni o‘qiganda “pounds” so‘zini unutmang yoki qisqa shaklni tanlang.
scenes.say: Ask about the tea. Ask about the cakes. Say the price: two pounds forty.
scenes.say_uz: Choy narxini so‘rang. Tortlar narxini so‘rang. Narxni ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) That's two pounds forty. / two forty
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “How much is the tea?” — bitta narsa, “is”. “How much are the cakes?” — ko‘plik, “are”. Uchinchisi: “That’s two pounds forty” yoki qisqacha “That’s two forty, please.” Agar “two pound forty” desangiz, Britaniyada og‘zaki nutqda ba’zan shunday eshitasiz, lekin “two pounds forty” — standart shakl.
scenes.say: How much is the tea? How much are the cakes? That's two pounds forty, please.
scenes.say_uz: Choy qancha? Tortlar qancha? Ikki funt qirq pens bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Hisobni so‘rash
board: Can I have the bill, please? (UK)
Can I have the check, please? (US)
Could we have the bill, please?
scenes.say_native: Restoranda ovqatlanib bo‘lgach, hisobni so‘rash kerak. Britaniyada “the bill” deyiladi: “Can I have the bill, please?” Amerikada esa “the check”: “Can I have the check, please?” Bir necha kishi bo‘lsangiz — “Could we have the bill, please?”
scenes.say: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please? Of course. Here you are.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, hisobni bera olasizmi? Albatta. Mana.

scenes.title: To‘lov
board: Here you are. · Keep the change.
scenes.say_native: To‘lov paytidagi iboralar. “Can I pay by card?” — karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Kassir so‘raydi: “Cash or card?” — naqdmi yoki kartami? Javob: “Card, please” yoki “Cash, please.” Pulni berayotganda “Here you are” — mana, deysiz. Qaytimni olmaslik uchun: “Keep the change” — qaytimi sizga.
scenes.say: Cash or card? Card, please. Can I pay by card? Yes, of course. Here you are. Keep the change.
scenes.say_uz: Naqdmi yoki karta? Karta. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Ha, albatta. Mana. Qaytimi sizga.

scenes.title: Hisob — account emas
board: ✓ Can I have the bill, please?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ko‘p qiladigan xato: “hisob” yoki “счёт” so‘zini “account” deb tarjima qilish. “Account” — bankdagi hisob raqam, restoranda u ishlatilmaydi. Restoranda faqat “the bill”, Amerikada “the check”. Va yana: “Give me the bill” buyruq bo‘lgani uchun qo‘pol eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Not: the account. Say: Can I have the bill, please?
scenes.say_uz: The account emas. Can I have the bill, please deng.

scenes.title: Nima deysiz?
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Birinchi: Londondagi restoranda ofitsiantdan hisobni so‘rang. Ikkinchi: karta bilan to‘lash mumkinligini so‘rang. Uchinchi: ofitsiantga pulni bering va qaytimni qoldirishini ayting. Har birini baland ovozda ayting. Har bir gapda muloyim shakl bo‘lsin, chunki bu xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi odamga murojaat.
scenes.say: Ask for the bill. Ask about paying by card. Give the money and leave the change.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobni so‘rang. Karta haqida so‘rang. Pulni bering va qaytimni qoldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Excuse me, can I have the bill, please?
3) Here you are. Keep the change.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Excuse me, can I have the bill, please?” Ikkinchisi: “Can I pay by card?” Uchinchisi: “Here you are. Keep the change.” Agar Amerikada bo‘lsangiz, birinchisida “check” deysiz. “Excuse me” bilan boshlash ofitsiantning e’tiborini muloyim tortadi, bu haqda hozir alohida gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: Excuse me, can I have the bill, please? Can I pay by card? Here you are. Keep the change.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, hisobni bera olasizmi? Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Mana. Qaytimi sizga.

scenes.title: Madaniyat: please va thank you
board: thank you / thanks — har bir xizmatdan keyin
scenes.say_native: Endi madaniyat haqida. Ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchi mamlakatlarda “please” va “thank you” juda ko‘p aytiladi. Ofitsiant menyuni berdi — “thank you”, choy keltirdi — “thanks”, hisobni berdi — yana “thank you”.
scenes.say: Here's your tea. Thank you! Here's the bill. Thanks very much. Cheers!
scenes.say_uz: Mana choyingiz. Rahmat! Mana hisob. Katta rahmat. Rahmat!

scenes.title: Ofitsiantni chaqirish
board: Excuse me! + qo‘l ko‘tarish / ko‘z bilan qarash
scenes.say_native: Ofitsiantni qanday chaqirish kerak? Eng yaxshi usul: unga qarab, qo‘lingizni biroz ko‘tarib, “Excuse me!” deyish. Britaniyada “Sorry!” ham shu ma’noda ishlatiladi: “Sorry, could I have some more water?” Barmoq bilan chertish, hushtak chalish, qarsak urish yoki baland ovozda baqirish juda qo‘pol hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: Excuse me! Could we have some more water, please? Sorry, could I have a spoon?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz! Yana suv bera olasizmi? Kechirasiz, qoshiq bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Qizim, uka — ishlatilmaydi
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekistonda ofitsiantni “qizim”, “singlim”, “uka” deb chaqiramiz va bu samimiy eshitiladi. Ingliz tiliga tarjima qilib “Girl!” yoki “Boy!” desangiz, juda qo‘pol va hatto haqoratli bo‘ladi. “Hey!” va “Waiter!” ham qo‘pol yoki eskicha. Faqat “Excuse me!” deng.
scenes.say: Not: Hey! Not: Waiter! Just say: Excuse me!
scenes.say_uz: Hey emas. Waiter emas. Shunchaki: Excuse me!

scenes.title: Choy puli va xizmat haqi
scenes.say_native: Choy puli “tip” deyiladi. Britaniyada restoranlarda ko‘pincha hisobga “service charge” — xizmat haqi qo‘shilgan bo‘ladi. Agar qo‘shilmagan bo‘lsa, taxminan o‘n foiz qoldirish odatiy. Bilmasangiz, so‘rang: “Is service included?” Amerikada esa tip odatda ancha katta, o‘n besh-yigirma foiz atrofida.
scenes.say: Is service included? Yes, it is. OK, thank you. No, it isn't. OK, I'll leave a tip.
scenes.say_uz: Xizmat haqi kiritilganmi? Ha. Yaxshi, rahmat. Yo‘q. Yaxshi, choy puli qoldiraman.

scenes.title: Taom haqida so‘rash
board: Does it have pork in it? (cho‘chqa go‘shti)
scenes.say_native: Menyudagi taomni tushunmasangiz, so‘rang: “What’s this?” yoki “What’s in it?” — ichida nima bor? “Is it spicy?” — achchiqmi? Ko‘pchiligimiz uchun muhim savol: “Does it have pork in it?” — ichida cho‘chqa go‘shti bormi? Shuningdek, “Is it halal?” deb ham so‘rash mumkin.
scenes.say: Excuse me, what's in this soup? Is it spicy? Does it have pork in it? Is it halal?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, bu sho‘rvada nima bor? Achchiqmi? Ichida cho‘chqa go‘shti bormi? Halolmi?

scenes.title: Muloyimmi yoki qo‘polmi?
board: 2) Excuse me, could I have the menu, please?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni o‘qing va har biri muloyimmi yoki qo‘polmi, aniqlang. Qo‘pol gaplarni o‘zingiz muloyim qilib qayta ayting. Qaror qilishda uchta belgiga qarang: “Excuse me” bormi, buyruq yoki “I want” bormi va “please” yoki “thank you” bormi. Shu uchta belgi sizga to‘g‘ri javobni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Polite or rude? One. Two. Three. Four.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyimmi yoki qo‘polmi? Bir. Ikki. Uch. To‘rt.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) rude → Excuse me, could I have the menu, please?
3) rude → Can I have the bill, please?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi gap qo‘pol: “Hey” va buyruq bor. To‘g‘risi ikkinchi gapga o‘xshaydi: “Excuse me, could I have the menu, please?” Ikkinchisi muloyim. Uchinchisi “I want” tufayli talabchan, uni “Can I have the bill, please?” deb ayting. To‘rtinchisi muloyim va samimiy.
scenes.say: Excuse me, could I have the menu, please? Can I have the bill, please?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, menyuni bera olasizmi? Hisobni bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi. “Can I have a…” iborasida “can” “ken” emas, qisqa “kən” bo‘ladi va so‘zlar ulanadi: “kən-ai-hæ-və”. “A cup of tea” da “of” deyarli “əv” bo‘lib, “cup” ga qo‘shiladi: “ə-kʌ-pəv-ti”.
scenes.say: Can I have a coffee? A cup of tea. A glass of water. I'd like a sandwich.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva bera olasizmi? Bir piyola choy. Bir stakan suv. Sendvich olardim.

scenes.title: Ulab ayting
board: Can I have a coffee, please?
I'd like a glass of water.
scenes.say_native: Uchta iborani avval sekin, keyin tez va ulab takrorlang. “Can” va “of” ni qisqa va kuchsiz ayting, urg‘uni esa asosiy so‘zlarga bering: “coffee”, “tea”, “water”. Agar qiyin bo‘lsa, iborani oxiridan boshlab mashq qiling: avval “please”, keyin “coffee, please”, keyin butun gap. Bu usul tilni tez moslashtiradi.
scenes.say: Can I have a coffee, please? A cup of tea, please. I'd like a glass of water.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva bera olasizmi? Bir piyola choy, iltimos. Bir stakan suv olardim.

scenes.title: Urg‘u qayerda?
board: can I HAVE a COFfee, PLEASE?
I'd LIKE a GLASS of WAter.
scenes.say_native: Tekshiring: urg‘u katta harflar bilan yozilgan so‘zlarga tushadi. “Coffee”, “cup”, “tea”, “glass”, “water” — bular ma’no tashiydi, shuning uchun aniq va balandroq. “A”, “of”, “can” esa yengil va tez. Agar har bir so‘zni bir xil kuch bilan aytsangiz, nutqingiz robotga o‘xshab qoladi.
scenes.say: Can I have a coffee, please? A cup of tea, please. I'd like a glass of water.
scenes.say_uz: Qahva bera olasizmi? Bir piyola choy, iltimos. Bir stakan suv olardim.

scenes.title: Tinglang: restoranda
board: Starter? Main course? How much? How do they pay?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog, uzunroq. Aziz va do‘sti Kate restoranda kechki ovqat qilyapti. Tinglang va to‘rt narsani eslab qoling: Aziz qaysi taomni oldi, Kate nima oldi, hisob qancha bo‘ldi va qanday to‘lashdi? Ofitsiantning savollariga ham e’tibor bering, ular sizga tanish.
scenes.say: Are you ready to order? Yes. I'd like the tomato soup, and then the lamb with rice, please. And for you? I'll have the fish and chips. Anything to drink? Two glasses of water, please. Later: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please? Sure. That's thirty-two pounds fifty. Can we pay by card? Of course.
scenes.say_uz: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz? Ha. Pomidor sho‘rvasi, keyin guruch bilan qo‘y go‘shti bersangiz. Sizga-chi? Men baliq va kartoshka olaman. Ichimlik? Ikki stakan suv, iltimos. Keyinroq: Kechirasiz, hisobni bera olasizmi? Albatta. O‘ttiz ikki funt ellik pens. Karta bilan to‘lasak bo‘ladimi? Albatta.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Aziz qanday birinchi va asosiy taom oldi? Kate nima oldi? Hisob qancha chiqdi? Ular naqd to‘ladimi yoki karta bilanmi? Javoblarni daftarga yozing. Narxni raqam bilan yozing, keyin uni so‘z bilan ham baland ovozda aytib ko‘ring, xuddi kassir kabi.
scenes.say: What does Aziz order? What does Kate order? How much is the bill? Do they pay in cash or by card?
scenes.say_uz: Aziz nima oldi? Kate nima oldi? Hisob qancha? Ular naqd to‘ladimi yoki karta bilanmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Aziz birinchi taomga pomidor sho‘rvasi, asosiy taomga guruch bilan qo‘y go‘shti oldi. Kate “fish and chips” oldi. Ikkalasi ham suv ichdi. Hisob o‘ttiz ikki funt ellik pens: “thirty-two pounds fifty”. Ular karta bilan to‘lashdi.
scenes.say: Aziz has the tomato soup and the lamb. Kate has fish and chips. The bill is thirty-two pounds fifty. They pay by card.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz pomidor sho‘rvasi va qo‘y go‘shti oladi. Kate baliq va kartoshka oladi. Hisob o‘ttiz ikki funt ellik pens. Ular karta bilan to‘laydi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: to‘liq buyurtma
board: Excuse me! → drink → starter → main course
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim mashq. Siz restorandasiz va men ofitsiantman. Ekrandagi rejaga qarab, butun buyurtmani o‘zingiz bering: ichimlik, birinchi taom, asosiy taom, xohlasangiz shirinlik. Keyin hisobni so‘rang va qanday to‘lashingizni ayting. Har bir iltimosda “please”, har bir xizmatdan keyin “thank you” bo‘lsin. Baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Good evening! Here's the menu. Are you ready to order?
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kech! Mana menyu. Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz?

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.
For a starter, the salad. Then the chicken and rice.
Could I have the bill, please? Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob bilan solishtiring. Ichimlik: “I’d like a glass of orange juice, please.” Taomlar: “For a starter, I’ll have the salad, and then the chicken and rice.” Shirinlikdan voz kechish: “No dessert, thank you.” Oxirida: “Excuse me, could I have the bill, please? Can I pay by card?”
scenes.say: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please. For a starter, I'll have the salad, and then the chicken and rice. No dessert, thank you. Could I have the bill, please? Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_uz: Bir stakan apelsin sharbati bersangiz. Birinchi taomga salat, keyin tovuq va guruch. Shirinlik kerak emas, rahmat. Hisobni bera olasizmi? Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: food & drinks · a cup / glass / bottle / piece of
I'd like… · Can / Could I have…? · Would you like…?
How much is / are…? · the bill · by card / in cash
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Ichimlik va ovqat nomlarini hamda “a cup of”, “a glass of” kabi idish iboralarini o‘rgandik. Muloyim buyurtma uchun “I’d like”, “Can I have” va “Could I have” ni, taklifga “Yes, please” va “No, thank you” bilan javob berishni bildik.
scenes.say: Well done! Now you can order food and drinks, ask about prices and pay the bill politely.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla! Endi siz ovqat va ichimlik buyurtma qila, narx so‘ray va hisobni muloyim to‘lay olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: I'd like / Can I have + please
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Restoranda to‘liq ovqatlanishni rolli o‘yin qilib bajaring: bir kishi ofitsiant, ikkinchisi mijoz, yoki ikkala rolni o‘zingiz o‘ynab, telefonga yozib oling. Dialogda ichimlik, birinchi va asosiy taom, shirinlik, narx so‘rash, hisob va to‘lov bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: See you next time. Enjoy your meal!
scenes.say_uz: Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Yoqimli ishtaha!

homework_uz: Restoranda to‘liq ovqatlanish bo‘yicha rolli o‘yin tuzing va ovoz yozib oling: ichimlik, birinchi va asosiy taom, shirinlik, narx so‘rash, hisob va to‘lov. Mezon: kamida 5 ta muloyim iltimos (I'd like / Can I have / Could we have + please), “Give me” va “I want” yo‘q, hisob uchun “the bill” ishlatilgan.

quiz.why_uz: Muloyim buyurtma: I'd like … please. Give me va I want qo‘pol yoki talabchan eshitiladi.

quiz.q: Complete: “Can I ___ a cup of tea, please?”
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida “Can I have…?” deyiladi — gap o‘zingizdan boshlanadi.

quiz.q: “Would you like some water?” — the best answer is:
quiz.why_uz: Taklifga qisqa javob: Yes, please. “Yes, I like” — xato.
Ko‘plikda: How much are…? Bitta narsada: How much is…?

quiz.q: In a British restaurant, you want to pay. You say:
options: Can I have the account, please?
Can I have the bill, please?
quiz.why_uz: Restoranda hisob — the bill (Amerikada the check). Account — bank hisobi.
Bread — sanalmaydigan so‘z: some bread yoki a slice of bread.

quiz.q: How do you call a waiter politely?
quiz.why_uz: Ofitsiantni faqat “Excuse me!” deb, qo‘l ko‘tarib chaqiramiz.
£4.50 — four pounds fifty yoki qisqacha four fifty.

quiz.q: The waiter says “Anything else?” You don't want more. You say:
quiz.why_uz: Boshqa narsa kerak bo‘lmasa: No, that's all, thanks.

quiz.q: “Eat in or take away?” In American English this is:
quiz.why_uz: Britaniyada Eat in or take away?, Amerikada For here or to go?
